name: Colors of Fate
source:
The story starts with Melia and her best friend Enris, at the age of 10 in their quiet village.

Life has always been calm and easy for our two inseparable best friends, but destiny isn't always sweet and smooth and nobody would have predicted that fate would prank them with an unfortunate joke. 

Now, who knows what will become of these kids in the future days, months and years?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=45&t=48943]Lemma Soft Forum[/url]]
translation:
故事从梅莉娅和她最好的朋友恩里斯十岁时开始，那时他们住在宁静的村庄里。

这两个形影不离的好友一直过着平静而安逸的生活，但命运并不总是甜蜜顺遂，谁也没想到，命运会用一个不幸的玩笑捉弄他们。

如今，谁知道这些孩子在未来的日子、数月乃至数年里会变成什么样？
